definitions: An instance of a particular situation; an example of something occurring.
A container or receptacle for holding or protecting something.
An incident or set of circumstances investigated by the police.
A legal action or suit to be decided in a court of law.
A grammatical category used to show the function of a noun or pronoun.
examples: He carried his violin in a hard case.
The police are working on the murder case.
The Latin word is in the accusative case.
